concept.hr: Vrijeme isporuke kapaciteta prema vršku opterećenja; prekid spot instance
concept.en: Capacity lead time against a load spike; spot preemption

summary.hr: Pošalji vršak opterećenja uz različito vrijeme isporuke: autoskaliranje reagira odmah, kapacitet stiže kasnije; spot kapacitet nestane i ne vraća se.
summary.en: Spike the load with different lead times: the autoscaler reacts at once, the capacity arrives later; spot capacity vanishes and does not come back.

concept.hr: Naručen u 0. taktu, stiže u 3.: tri takta zasićenja, zatim ρ 0,53 i p99 0,66 s
concept.en: Ordered at tick 0, online at 3: three ticks saturated, then ρ 0.53, p99 0.66 s

concept.hr: Vrijeme isporuke 1 takt: zasićen samo 2. takt, zatim ρ 0,70
concept.en: Lead time 1 tick: only tick 2 saturated, then ρ 0.70

concept.hr: Vrijeme isporuke 4 takta: četiri takta zasićenja u vršku od pet
concept.en: Lead time 4 ticks: four saturated ticks in a five-tick spike

concept.hr: Isporuka 9 taktova: cijeli vršak zasićen, kapacitet stiže kad više ne treba
concept.en: Lead time 9 ticks: the whole spike saturated, capacity arrives when not needed

concept.hr: Ispad jednog ormara zasiti uslugu; spot blok nestane i ne vraća se
concept.en: One rack down saturates the service; the spot block is reclaimed and stays gone
